hypotheses.P0_exact_and_numerically_small_residual: The edge partition and integrated output allocation recompose, and the float32 attention residual contributes less than 1% of the declared effect.
hypotheses.P1_H2_after_boundary_is_finitely_causal: Freezing all L17H2 post-boundary edges mediates at least 15% of the signed spelling effect and beats the 95th random-contrast percentile in every cell.
hypotheses.P2_same_relation_control_heads_are_weak: The corresponding H1 and H6 post-boundary freezes each mediate less than 5% in every cell.
hypotheses.P3_post_boundary_support_is_not_one_dist: No one H2 post-boundary distance bin accounts for more than 75% of positive H2 post-boundary line-integral contribution in any cell.
hypotheses.P4_top_distance_relation_replicates: The leading H2 post-boundary distance bin agrees across both splits in at least two of three folds.
hypotheses.P5_local_allocation_predicts_finite_prog: Across the tested native edge groups, line-integral contribution and finite mediation have Pearson correlation at least 0.7 in every cell.
